examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

вывести.gloss: to lead out, to take out; to drive mad

meanings.en: to lead out, to take out, to escort out
to drive mad, to make lose one's temper

examples.text: Посмотри, какой ты дерзкий! Может, тебя отсюда вывести?
examples.trans: Look how cheeky you are! Maybe you should be escorted out of here?
Security, get this scum out of here.

examples.text: Его так легко вывести из себя?
examples.trans: Is it that easy to make him lose his temper?

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: Это секрет, который умрёт вместе со мной.
examples.trans: It's a secret that will die with me.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.en: a bit easier, feeling better (comparative of легко)

meanings.note: полегче на поворотах! = take it easy!

examples.text: Ну что, тебе хоть немного полегче?
examples.trans: Well, do you feel even a little better?
Lie down for a while and you will feel a bit better.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

examples.text: Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша? Это полный кошмар!
examples.trans: Well, what can I tell you, Arkasha? This is a total nightmare!

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

examples.text: Да, я наведу здесь железный порядок.
examples.trans: Yes, I'll establish iron order here.

meanings.note: usually short form похож/похожа/похожи + на + accusative

examples.trans: He looks very much like his father.

examples.text: Нормально у вас тут, просторно. И маскировка хорошая, на дворников похожи.
examples.trans: It's nice in here, roomy. And good disguises—you look like janitors.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?
examples.trans: I made a cake. Do you have a sweet tooth?

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: also figurative: to waste away somewhere

examples.text: А эта яма сгниёт без меня.
examples.trans: And this dump will rot without me.

examples.text: Если не выбросите фрукты, они сгниют.
examples.trans: If you don't throw out the fruit, it will rot.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

examples.text: Хорошая, никто же не говорит. Эй, ты что?
examples.trans: She is good, nobody's saying she isn't. Hey, what's wrong?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
pit, hole in the ground; pothole in a road

examples.text: А вы сегодня закатали яму во дворе.
examples.trans: And today you paved over a pothole in the courtyard.
There was a deep pothole in the road.
We're in a real hole right now.
